annotations.title: Live Technical SEO & AI Crawler Readiness Audit

description: Perform a live single-URL on-page HTML DOM and HTTP response header crawl to diagnose technical SEO and page-level indexability issues (distinct from 'agent_crawler_traffic_attribution', which analyzes domain-wide bot log telemetry and analytics regex). Use this tool to inspect a specific page 'url' for broken heading hierarchies, missing canonical or meta tags, embedded Schema.org JSON-LD validity, and '/llms.txt' presence. Returns HTTP status, TTFB latency, title and meta tags, H1-H3 DOM structure, Schema.org validation, and a prioritized technical health score.

check_ai_crawlers.description: When true, fetches /robots.txt on the target origin to verify whether GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot are permitted (default: true).

check_llms_txt.description: When true, probes /llms.txt on the target origin for machine-readable agent documentation (default: true).

check_schema_org.description: When true, parses and validates embedded application/ld+json Schema.org blocks on the page (default: true).

url.description: Full HTTP/HTTPS URL or domain to crawl and audit in real time (e.g., "https://argosor.com").

name: technical_seo_crawl
title: Live On-Page HTML DOM & HTTP Technical SEO Crawl
